1a.speaker: TV
1a.en: With twelve hours until the Kyoto Summit, delegates from around the world are arriving in Kyoto.
cards: With twelve hours until the|Kyoto Summit,
delegates from around the|world are arriving in Kyoto.

1b.speaker: TV
1b.en: Recent polls at home and abroad show growing support for a complete quarantine of Neo Kobe, apparently driven by fears of Snatcher infiltration.
cards: Recent polls at home and|abroad show growing support
for a complete quarantine|of Neo Kobe,
apparently driven by fears|of Snatcher infiltration.

1c.speaker: Mika
1c.en: The chief's death is confirmed, so JUNKER will soon lose its authority.
cards: The chief's death is|confirmed,
so JUNKER will soon lose|its authority.

1d.speaker: Metal Gear
1d.en: The summit will decide Neo Kobe's fate in twelve hours.
cards: The summit will|decide Neo Kobe's|fate in twelve|hours.

1e.speaker: Mika
1e.en: They say a nuclear bomb will wipe out the city and its Snatchers.
cards: They say a nuclear bomb|will wipe out the city
and its Snatchers.

1f.speaker: Gillian
cards: Insane! In the 21st|century?

20.speaker: Metal Gear
20.en: It's not just a rumor. Every country fears the spread of Snatchers.
cards: It's not just a|rumor. Every|country fears the|spread of Snatchers.

21.speaker: Mika
21.en: The chief was going to the summit to stop that. But now there's no hope.
cards: The chief was going|to the summit to|stop that. But now|there's no hope.

22.speaker: Metal Gear
22.en: The government began pressuring JUNKER several months ago.
cards: The government|began pressuring|JUNKER several|months ago.

23.speaker: Metal Gear
23.en: Your transfer to JUNKER was our last chance, Gillian.
cards: Your transfer to|JUNKER was our last|chance, Gillian.

24.speaker: Gillian
24.en: Now that even the chief was snatched, they have even less reason to trust JUNKER.
cards: Now that even the|chief was snatched,
they have even less|reason to trust|JUNKER.

25.speaker: Mika
25.en: The military and FBI will apparently take over.
cards: The military and|FBI will apparently|take over.

26.speaker: Metal Gear
26.en: Yes. That will also be decided in twelve hours.
cards: Yes. That will also|be decided in|twelve hours.

27.speaker: Gillian
27.en: Twelve hours to find their hideout.
cards: Twelve hours to find|their hideout.

28.speaker: Gillian
28.en: Or we're dead, along with everyone in the city.
cards: Or we're dead, along|with everyone in the city.

29.speaker: Gillian
29.en: To them, this city's a tumor. Cut it out and sink it.
cards: To them, this city's|a tumor. Cut it out and sink it.

2a.speaker: Metal Gear
2a.en: We have to strike the Snatchers' base before that.
cards: We have to strike|the Snatchers' base|before that.

2b.speaker: Mika
cards: Can you do it, Gillian?

2c.speaker: Gillian
2c.en: If we can find their hideout.
cards: If we can find their|hideout.

2d.speaker: Metal Gear
2d.en: Attacking places like Queen Hospital won't help. We have to hit their main base.
cards: Attacking places|like Queen Hospital|won't help.
We have to hit|their main base.

2e.speaker: Gillian
2e.en: What about the chief Snatcher's memory?
cards: What about the|chief Snatcher's|memory?

2f.speaker: Metal Gear
2f.en: Completely erased, as before. A form of self-destruction.
cards: Completely erased,|as before. A form|of self-destruction.

30.speaker: Gillian
30.en: That's right, Metal Gear. What about tracing Jamie's videophone call?
cards: That's right, Metal|Gear.
What about tracing|Jamie's videophone call?

31.speaker: Metal Gear
31.en: There wasn't enough time. But it definitely came from somewhere in this city.
cards: There wasn't enough|time.
But it definitely|came from somewhere|in this city.

32.speaker: Gillian
32.en: Damn it! Where? Where are they?
cards: Damn it! Where? Where|are they?

33.speaker: Mika
33.en: Can't you remember anything, Gillian? Did Jamie say anything about a connection to the Snatchers?
cards: Can't you remember|anything, Gillian?
Did Jamie say anything|about a connection to the Snatchers?

34.speaker: Gillian
cards: I can't remember a|thing.

35.speaker: Gillian
35.en: Metal, tell me everything you know about who I am! Why was I sent to JUNKER? Where did I come from?
cards: Metal, tell me|everything you know about who I am!
Why was I sent to|JUNKER? Where did I come from?

36.speaker: Mika
cards: Gillian...

37.speaker: Gillian
37.en: The Chief's gone, too! Tell me what you know, Metal!
cards: The Chief's gone,|too! Tell me what|you know, Metal!

38.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: Well, you see...

39.speaker: Gillian
cards: Metal!

3a.speaker: Metal Gear
3a.en: Understood. With the chief dead, you're in command now.
cards: Understood. With|the chief dead,|you're in command|now.

3b.speaker: Mika
cards: You knew?

3c.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: Of course.

3d.speaker: Gillian
cards: Where were we|rescued?

3e.speaker: Metal Gear
3e.en: You and Jamie were rescued three years ago, on September 25, 2039, from the Siberian neutral zone by the seventeenth Siberian expedition.
cards: You and Jamie were|rescued three years|ago, on September|25, 2039,
from the Siberian|neutral zone by the|seventeenth|Siberian expedition.

3f.speaker: Metal Gear
3f.en: To be precise, you were found in cryogenic pods in an underground shelter near Moscow.
cards: To be precise, you|were found in cryogenic pods
in an underground|shelter near Moscow.

40.speaker: Gillian
cards: Cryogenic sleep?|Artificial hibernation?

41.speaker: Metal Gear
41.en: This photo was taken at the time.
cards: This photo was|taken at the time.

42.speaker: Metal Gear
42.en: We don't know how long you'd been asleep there. A third, empty pod was found with you.
cards: We don't know how|long you'd been|asleep there.
A third, empty pod|was found with you.

43.speaker: Gillian
cards: Three pods?

44.speaker: Metal Gear
44.en: You were revived and placed under military protection. You had both lost all your memories, perhaps from prolonged cryogenic sleep.
cards: You were revived|and placed under|military|protection.
You had both lost|all your memories,
perhaps from|prolonged cryogenic|sleep.

45.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: Or perhaps they'd|been erased.

46.speaker: Metal Gear
46.en: This was your only possession when you were rescued.
cards: This was your only|possession when you|were rescued.

47.speaker: Mika
47.en: Isn't that a picture of Harry as a child?
cards: Isn't that a|picture of Harry as|a child?

48.speaker: Metal Gear
48.en: Yes. Harry is your son, yours and Jamie's. DNA tests confirmed it.
cards: Yes. Harry is your|son, yours and|Jamie's. DNA tests|confirmed it.

49.speaker: Gillian
49.en: The old man was my son?
cards: The old man was my|son?

4a.speaker: Metal Gear
4a.en: Using the photo's data, we identified you as Gillian Seed and Jamie Lorraine.
cards: Using the photo's|data, we identified|you as Gillian Seed|and Jamie Lorraine.

4b.speaker: Metal Gear
4b.en: Both American citizens, born in the 1970s.
cards: Both American|citizens, born in|the 1970s.

4c.speaker: Mika
cards: The 1970s?

4d.speaker: Metal Gear
4d.en: You both disappeared in 1985. There are no records of you after that.
cards: You both|disappeared in|1985.
There are no|records of you|after that.

4f.speaker: Metal Gear
4f.en: Yes. You come from the world of fifty years ago.
cards: Yes. You come from|the world of fifty|years ago.

50.speaker: Mika
50.en: But what does that have to do with the Snatchers?
cards: But what does that|have to do with the|Snatchers?

51.speaker: Metal Gear
51.en: Well, the expedition that rescued you had an accident on the way back. You both survived, but most of the team died.
cards: Well, the|expedition
that rescued you|had an accident on|the way back.
You both survived,|but most of the|team died.

52.speaker: Metal Gear
52.en: There was a Snatcher among them.
cards: There was a|Snatcher among them.

53.speaker: Metal Gear
53.en: They'd all been thoroughly examined before departure. So if they were snatched...
cards: They'd all been|thoroughly examined|before departure.
So if they were|snatched...

54.speaker: Gillian
cards: Somewhere in Siberia.

55.speaker: Metal Gear
55.en: Yes. The government sent you both to JUNKER to learn your identities and uncover the truth about Snatchers.
cards: Yes.
The government sent|you both to JUNKER
to learn your|identities and|uncover the truth|about Snatchers.

56.speaker: Metal Gear
56.en: They hoped contact with Snatchers would restore your memories.
cards: They hoped contact|with Snatchers|would restore your|memories.

57.speaker: Gillian
cards: Moscow, fifty years|ago.

58.speaker: Metal Gear
58.en: Almost everyone who knew Moscow then died in the outbreak.
cards: Almost everyone who|knew Moscow then|died in the|outbreak.

59.speaker: Mika
59.en: So you two are the only living witnesses.
cards: So you two are the only|living witnesses.

5a.speaker: Gillian
5a.en: The old man. Harry was our son.
cards: The old man. Harry|was our son.

5b.speaker: Gillian
cards: Did he know?

5c.speaker: Metal Gear
5c.en: No. It was top secret. He was told nothing.
cards: No. It was top|secret. He was told|nothing.

5d.speaker: Gillian
5d.en: My God. I couldn't do anything for him.
cards: My God. I couldn't|do anything for him.

5e.speaker: Mika
5e.en: Wait, Gillian. Didn't Jamie say they were holding her child hostage?
cards: Wait, Gillian.|Didn't Jamie say|they were holding|her child hostage?

5f.speaker: Gillian
5f.en: That's it! They're using Harry to threaten Jamie.
cards: That's it! They're|using Harry to|threaten Jamie.

60.speaker: Metal Gear
60.en: We must find their hideout, fast!
cards: We must find their|hideout, fast!

61.speaker: Gillian
cards: We have twelve|hours.

62.speaker: Mika
62.en: Gillian, let's review what we know. We might find a clue.
cards: Gillian, let's review|what we know. We might find a clue.

63.speaker: Gillian
63.en: Right. Their behavior might tell us something.
cards: Right. Their behavior|might tell us something.

64.speaker: Metal Gear
64.en: Let's go over what we've learned about the Snatchers.
cards: Let's go over what|we've learned about|the Snatchers.

65.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: First, what is|their weakness?

66.speaker: Mika
66.en: It may be a kind of homing instinct. Their base might be somewhere that reminds them of their creator. I've seen many similar cases in criminal psychology.
cards: It may be a kind of|homing instinct.
Their base might be|somewhere that|reminds them of|their creator.
I've seen many|similar cases in|criminal psychology.

67.speaker: Gillian
67.en: Somewhere in this city that resembles Moscow.
cards: Somewhere in this|city that resembles|Moscow.

68.speaker: Mika
68.en: Moscow's cold, isn't it? It snows there in winter?
cards: Moscow's cold, isn't it?|It snows there in winter?

69.speaker: Gillian
cards: Snow?

6a.speaker: Metal Gear
6a.en: It hasn't snowed in Neo Kobe for years.
cards: It hasn't snowed in|Neo Kobe for years.

6b.speaker: Mika
cards: Then that's not it.

6c.speaker: Gillian
6c.en: Wait. What about that pollen? Snow Cedar!
cards: Wait. What about that|pollen? Snow Cedar!

6d.speaker: Mika
6d.en: There was snow in Jamie's videophone call, too.
cards: There was snow in|Jamie's videophone|call, too.

6e.speaker: Gillian
6e.en: That's it! Their hideout is somewhere along the Ina River.
cards: That's it!
Their hideout is|somewhere along the Ina River.

6f.speaker: Mika
6f.en: But the Ina River covers too much ground.
cards: But the Ina River covers|too much ground.

70.speaker: Metal Gear
70.en: Let's put everything we've discussed on a map, Gillian.
cards: Let's put|everything we've|discussed on a map,|Gillian.

71.speaker: Metal Gear
71.en: This is an enlarged map of the Ina River area in southwestern Neo Kobe City.
cards: This is an enlarged|map of the Ina|River area
in southwestern Neo|Kobe City.

72.speaker: Metal Gear
72.en: The blue areas show where Snow Cedar grows.
cards: The blue areas show|where Snow Cedar|grows.

73.speaker: Metal Gear
73.en: Now I'll overlay the Tube Liner routes.
cards: Now I'll overlay|the Tube Liner|routes.

74.speaker: Metal Gear
74.en: I'll isolate the areas where the routes and cedars overlap.
cards: I'll isolate the|areas where the|routes and cedars|overlap.

75.speaker: Gillian
75.en: It's still too big. All that ground in twelve hours?
cards: It's still too big.|All that ground in|twelve hours?

76.speaker: Mika
76.en: Don't give up, Gillian. If it reminds them of home, perhaps the geography is similar, too. The same terrain would give them the same view.
cards: Don't give up,|Gillian.
If it reminds them|of home, perhaps|the geography is|similar, too.
The same terrain|would give them the|same view.

77.speaker: Metal Gear
77.en: I'll display a map of Moscow beside it.
cards: I'll display a map|of Moscow beside it.

78.speaker: Gillian
cards: Huh? Look at that!

79.speaker: Mika
79.en: Look! The rivers have the same shape!
cards: Look! The rivers|have the same shape!

7a.speaker: Metal Gear
7a.en: This one is the Moskva River.
cards: This one is the|Moskva River.

7b.speaker: Gillian
7b.en: Looks like our theory was right. Metal, show us where Jamie and I were rescued.
cards: Looks like our|theory was right.
Metal, show us|where Jamie and I|were rescued.

7c.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: Understood.

7d.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: Here.

7e.speaker: Gillian
7e.en: Metal, what was here before the Catastrophe?
cards: Metal, what was|here before the|Catastrophe?

7f.speaker: Metal Gear
7f.en: The Kremlin. The nerve center of the Soviet Union.
cards: The Kremlin. The|nerve center of the|Soviet Union.

80.speaker: Mika
80.en: The Kremlin? The Snatcher said he was taking Jamie to the Kremlin!
cards: The Kremlin? The|Snatcher said he|was taking Jamie to|the Kremlin!

81.speaker: Gillian
81.en: Metal, what part of this city corresponds to the Kremlin?
cards: Metal, what part of|this city|corresponds to the|Kremlin?

82.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: Understood.

83.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: Found it. An old|church.

84.speaker: Metal Gear
84.en: A huge, empty church. It's been in ruins for twenty years.
cards: A huge, empty|church. It's been|in ruins for twenty|years.

85.speaker: Mika
85.en: Right where the Snow Cedars and subway routes overlap!
cards: Right where the|Snow Cedars and|subway routes|overlap!

86.speaker: Gillian
86.en: That's it! Their main base. A second Kremlin!
cards: That's it! Their|main base. A second|Kremlin!

87.speaker: Metal Gear
cards: Let's hurry,|Gillian!

88.speaker: Mika
cards: Wait, Gillian!
